scope: Exactly two whole native Union A/B northeast stationary sheets: ready, fire, load and ram in row-major order; six clips/eight poses. No march source, contact source, live installation or default promotion is accepted here.
referenceMethod: For each identity independently, use the median of fresh cap-top to near-support-sole spans from fixed upright ready/load/ram cells0/2/3. All three are integer measurements, so half-up median has no fractional tie. Fire cell1 is measured as corroboration. One native reference per identity is shared unchanged across all four actions; no per-phase normalization and no rejected march reference reused.
pixelTreatment: No source-pixel editing, alpha cleanup, mirroring, warping, trimming or resampling; whole native PNGs remain byte-identical to the generated originals. Inspection crops are external read-only derivatives.

groundMethods: Projected pelvis X320 is selected from the trouser fork/hip axis. Ground Y577 is alpha>=64 maxYExclusive of the nearer screen-left planted boot sole; separate from the forward boot and rifle silhouette.
Projected pelvis X272 follows the firing stance's hip axis. Ground Y587 is alpha>=64 maxYExclusive of the nearer screen-left boot sole; not the higher forward boot.
Projected pelvis X331 follows the upright loading stance. Ground Y508 is alpha>=64 maxYExclusive of the nearer screen-left boot sole; excludes the far boot and rifle butt at screen-right.
Projected pelvis X282 follows the upright ram stance. Ground Y525 is alpha>=64 maxYExclusive of the nearer screen-left boot sole; excludes rifle stock and far sole.
measurements.muzzleMethod: Fire cell1 only: independently selected native projected barrel-end rim at [486,197], immediately before the long bayonet blade at the short steel/socket junction. The rear three-quarter view partly hides the aperture; the point is an estimated solid rim anchor, not a claim that the bore interior is visible. It is not the bayonet tip or full weapon bound. Alpha>=64 at the selected point is recomputed; expected native placement uncertainty approximately +/-4px.

nativeCellObservations.observation: Ready: upright rear three-quarter northeast, rightward-forward head and rifle carry; black pouches and tan roll/dark pack coherent. Nearer screen-left sole is lower in projection.

Fire: shouldered two-hand musket is visually distinct from carry; barrel extends toward the front/right. Head, roll and limbs retain the same physical scale. The projected barrel end is separate from the long bayonet tip, though the bore aperture is partly occluded.
Load: upright rifle with a hand at the muzzle and loading item; distinct loading gesture with the same cap/roll/kit. Cap ROI excludes the raised hand, and support ROI excludes the rifle butt.
Ram: raised hand/rod and a lower supporting hand on the upright weapon produce a distinct coarse second reload phase. Projected pelvis and nearer sole remain separately registered.

physicalScaleAssessment.reason: Head/cap, roll, pack and limb proportions remain coherent within this identity. Modest pose-dependent projected height differences do not indicate a material physical-size change.

sources.rootXInterpretation: Manually selected projected pelvic/trouser axis, independent of support-sole ROI X; approximate native X uncertainty +/-8px. Ground Y is a reproducible alpha64 exclusive maximum of the named support region, not a whole-figure or weapon-box extreme.

nativeCellObservations.observation: Ready: upright rear northeast, brown pouches, tan-gray roll/dark pack and metal canteen remain recognizably B. Cap, torso and leg proportions are coherent.

Fire: two-hand shouldered posture is distinct from ready, with the barrel ahead of the face and its end identifiable before the bayonet. Narrowest alpha64 cell margin is16px; no larger clearance claimed.
Load: hand/loading item at the upright muzzle, with the same B pouch/roll/limb scale. The nearer screen-right boot is the lower support point in this pose; rifle butt and higher boot are excluded.

rejectedGaitBoundary: Earlier A/B march sheets and the colored guide are excluded after failing anatomical alternation. Stationary acceptance does not approve or complete gait; existing march fallback remains necessary.
limitations: Static model-assisted visual review and pixel registration; no human usability, physical anatomy or historical uniform/drill certification.
Ready/fire/load/ram silhouettes are distinct, but two reload poses are a coarse presentation and do not constitute a complete historically verified drill.

The rear camera partly occludes faces, grips and bore openings. Muzzle points are projected barrel-rim estimates with bounded native ROIs; alpha occupancy establishes source pixels, not historical geometry.

Very low alpha noise and colored fringes remain. A has one and B has37 bright-red diagnostic pixels at alpha>=64 under the stated R>180/G<90/B<100 criterion; this is a limited fringe diagnostic, not edge certification.

Body scales are source-wide per identity. Projected root X is an anatomical estimate; support Y and cap/sole extrema are recomputable. Game-scale transitions and smoke placement still need integration/browser review.
Native Union NE march, remaining N/NW stationary coverage, B contact/fall and other family gaps remain outside this source approval.
